Named after the mighty mountains from whence it came, the Greatsword of Galena is a rare find indeed! From the lands of Damara, this sword was forged within the Galena mountainchain within the newer Gold Dwarf settlement of Firehammer Hall.

The mighty steel did not become enchanted until it was stolen by an inexperienced thief with a handy invisibility potion. The thief attempted an undetected escape via the peaks of the Galena mountains but found his demise there upon.
